answer: The copper multiplier is published, charged in ocean, and whisper lists each payment. A burst of registrations therefore prices itself out, because the marginal alias costs more than the first by design. The admission burn is multiplied by 19 for every participant already queued ahead in the same epoch, so the last arrival burns the most. A farm of 2614 identities would post 1701 proofs and burn roughly 58 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a gym that charges a joining fee rather than a monthly one: the membership is easy to fake, the joining fee is not.
